covered_report_window.plain_language: After the Wednesday, October 14, 2026 U.S. close through before the Thursday, October 15, 2026 U.S. open.

market_context_summary: September CPI accelerated to 3.7% year over year, above 3.6% expected; Treasury yields rose and growth stocks weakened. This lifts rate sensitivity and raises the forward-guidance bar.

methodology.consensus_rule: Arithmetic mean of independent Pass A, B, and C scores and reversal risks.
methodology.disparity_rule: 0-100 combined dispersion; lower is tighter agreement.
methodology.lessons_review: Existing expectation-bar, key-metric-first, and forward-look overrides applied; no new method change.
